aquamirae_nouveau.description.armor_shat: Apply Aquamirae armor shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to five; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces armor by 10%. Source and scribing ingredient: Shatterspike.
aquamirae_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_armor: Apply Aquamirae armor shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to five; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces armor by 10%. Source and scribing ingredient: Shatterspike.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_armor_sha: Add effect levels up to the native limit.
aquamirae_nouveau.description.health_sha: Apply Aquamirae health shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to ten; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces maximum health by 5%. This does not heal the target when it expires. Source and scribing ingredient: Shatterblade.
aquamirae_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_healt: Apply Aquamirae health shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to ten; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces maximum health by 5%. This does not heal the target when it expires. Source and scribing ingredient: Shatterblade.

aquamirae_nouveau.description.fury_of_th: Apply Aquamirae Fury of the Depths for 30 seconds. Each level adds 10% to the native Depths Fury attribute, up to five levels. It improves damage against creatures tagged as affected by Depths Fury (ice maze creatures by default), and scales native weapon abilities. It is not universal Strength. Source and scribing ingredient: Esca (native food buff).

aquamirae_nouveau.description.resilience: Apply Aquamirae Resilience of the Depths for 30 seconds. Each level adds 10% to the native Depths Resilience attribute, up to five levels. It improves armor effectiveness and reduces the chance and multiplier of native critical hits from creatures tagged as affected by Depths Resilience (ice maze creatures by default). It is not universal Resistance. Source and scribing ingredient: Cooked Spinefish (native food buff).

aquamirae_nouveau.description.abyssal_sh: NeoForge only. Replace a projectile carrier with the native shard from Dreadwake. Write Projectile, Abyssal Shard, then effects: the primary shard resolves them at its impact. Normal projectiles home on hostile mobs within 16 blocks, deal 10 base damage and inflict Weakness I for 2.5 seconds; they split into three half-sized native shards. Split children do not carry Ars effects. Orbit and other managed carriers retain their Ars trajectory; repeated carriers pay at each impact and remain intact. Amplify raises scale by 0.2, capped at 2. Source and scribing ingredient: Dreadwake tier-two ability.
